labels.label: bzprop:c1s2p2_base_cone
findings: Witness only (the label is WP-45n's, closed in its corrected form and marked in Cone/Base). DEC-122's n ≤ 2 THEOREM, formalized in full: for a Hausdorff affine conical manifold of Benzécri's dimension n ≤ 2 (Lean: base index n ≤ 1, V charted on RnO (n+1), with HasGroupoid and HasConeCharts), the action of ℝ₊* is proper (Benzecri.LowDim.properSMul_of_le_one) and the base B = V/ℝ⁺ is Hausdorff (Benzecri.LowDim.t2Space_coneBase_of_le_one), so Prop. 2, Déf. 3 and p. 241 hold as printed in that range (with Cone/Section's second countability for the section). n = 1: GU(1) = {±1} preserves ‖·‖ (norm_smul_GU_one). n = 2: along an ultrafilter the transition between the two cone charts is eventually constant: each component of the overlap near the ray of f(m) either reaches it or has an interior endpoint that, V being Hausdorff, its transition sends to one of the two boundary rays of the target cone, and two components sent to the same boundary ray coincide (intermediate value theorem + injectivity of the target chart). It fails for every n ≥ 3 (Cone/Counterexample, DEC-124).

Lean declarations of this witness (not row decls): Benzecri.LowDim.properSMul_of_le_one, Benzecri.LowDim.t2Space_coneBase_of_le_one, Benzecri.LowDim.properSMul_dim_one, Benzecri.LowDim.properSMul_dim_two, Benzecri.LowDim.exists_endpoint, Benzecri.LowDim.eventually_eq_of_left, Benzecri.LowDim.eventually_eq_of_right.

kb_proposals: Properness of an ℝ₊*-action on a cone manifold reduces, by Mathlib's properSMul_iff_continuousSMul_ultrafilter_tendsto_t2, to the convergence of the radii ‖f'(m_i)‖ in ONE cone chart at the limit point m' (ConeBase.tendsto_fst_of_tendsto_radius); an ultrafilter then turns « finitely many transitions » into « eventually one transition » (Ultrafilter.eventually_or).
notes: New module. Import line for the root: `import BenzecriScaffold.Cone.LowDim` (imports Cone.Base only). The full statement is proved, no sorry, no tagged exception: DEC-122's « the theorem that B is Hausdorff for n ≤ 2 » is formalized. One LOCAL instance (uniqueFinZeroAddOne : Unique (Fin (0 + 1)), attribute [local instance]); no global instance. Build: lake build BenzecriScaffold.Cone.LowDim OK; lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true clean; every constant of the module: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

fixed: the numbered-item citation of DEC-122 (which has no numbered items) replaced by a quotation of DEC-122; « fails for n = 3 » now « every n ≥ 3 » (the counterexample is formalized in every dimension, DEC-124). Docstring of Cone/LowDim updated the same way (two lines).
